units.source_heading: Make treatment fit into daily life
units.source_text: The usual metastatic starting dose is ribociclib 600 mg once daily on Days 1–21 followed by Days 22–28 off. Continue the prescribed aromatase inhibitor (AI) daily or fulvestrant on its own injection schedule; add ovarian suppression when indicated. Continue while beneficial and tolerated.
units.reason: The complete source statement occurs in current consolidated narrative under approved acronym normalization.

units.source_heading: Make treatment fit into daily life
units.source_text: Take ribociclib once daily with or without food; swallow whole. Avoid grapefruit. If a dose is missed or vomited, do not take an extra dose; take the next scheduled dose. Confirm any clinical hold and restart with the team. The endocrine partner follows a separate prescription.
units.reason: The complete source statement occurs in current consolidated narrative under approved acronym normalization.

units.source_heading: Your endocrine partner has a separate timetable
units.source_text: An aromatase inhibitor is normally taken daily through the targeted-medicine rest week. If fulvestrant is the chosen partner, the usual schedule is 500 mg by intramuscular injection on Days 1, 15 and 29, then once monthly; confirm the prescribed dose and appointment dates. Any ovarian-suppression injections have their own schedule.
